Should You Repair or Replace Your AC?

Knowing whether to repair or replace your AC is not always obvious. The right decision depends on your system's age, condition, repair history, energy use, and how well it keeps your home comfortable.

Repair may make sense if:

 

    • Your system is newer

    • The issue is minor or isolated

    • Your energy bills are still reasonable

    • The system has been reliable overall

Replacement may be the better option if:

 

    • Your AC is 10 to 15+ years old

    • Repairs are becoming frequent

    • Your energy bills keep rising

    • Certain rooms never cool properly

    • The system struggles during peak summer heat

    • Repair costs are high compared to system age

A professional evaluation can help determine whether your issue is the equipment, airflow, ductwork, thermostat, or a combination of factors.
